summary: Frontend-only regression test of Pre-Book Review page restyle (bento cards, pill buttons, deadline chip, side-by-side status cards, light stat cards with MOQ %, zebra table, status pills). All functional selectors and flows verified. Zero console errors.

issues: When Purchasing preview 'Details' is expanded, the Consolidation details table (Order/Channel/Type + Units column) overflows past the right viewport edge; right-most Units column values get clipped. Consider allowing the details block to reflow below at narrow widths, or reduce column widths / add horizontal scroll container.

action_items: Address horizontal overflow of Purchasing-preview consolidation table at 1280px width when pb-preview-details is expanded (details card extends beyond right viewport edge).
critical_code_review_comments: pb-cons-toggle is only rendered after pb-preview-details is expanded; that is expected but worth documenting in the review-request selector list to avoid confusion.
pb-new-prebook only exists under the Setup tab (not Review) — matches expected behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at 1920x1080: Header shows 'SS27 / Drop 3' + OPEN pill + 'Deadline 9/21/2026' + '7 days left' chip. pb-more-btn opens pb-more-menu; pb-actions-btn opens pb-actions-menu. Status row shows Ready card + Purchasing preview side-by-side; pb-preview-details toggles body; pb-cons-toggle then shows pb-cons-table (Consolidation details table: #444/#443/#442/#441 with USW/DIST channel pills). Stat cards - pb-stat-combined: 13,328 units, $130K wholesale, 43% MOQ, 'MOQ hit 43%' 9/21 SKUs. pb-stat-usw: 932 / $19K / 10% / 2/21. pb-stat-dist: 12,396 / $112K / 38% / 8/21. SKU Demand table filters (pb-demand-all/hit/under) and pb-panel-search work; pb-sku-row-* click reveals pb-sku-expand-*. pb-subtab-orders shows orders with pb-order-selectall and 4x pb-order-menu-*. Sidebar drops: pb-drop-drop1/drop2/drop3 switch (drop1&drop2 CLOSED, drop3 OPEN 21). Setup tab shows pb-new-prebook button. Only design nit: consolidation details table overflows right edge at 1280 wide when preview details expanded.
